purpose: Reproducibility gate. A stranger must be able to obtain the exact framework source this project was generated, built and validated against using only public upstream repositories: clone the commits below, apply the patches below, and get the same tree. Docs and scripts must never pin a revision that exists only on the machine that wrote them.

framework.identity_note: The framework tree this project was validated against is NOT an upstream commit by itself: it carries project changes. The previous pin (bcaeae1f881e795f7df29952e71cf0205ac30a87) was a locally created content-identity commit that no stranger could fetch; it is superseded by upstream commit + patch set and must not be used again.

submodules.why: the framework's .gitmodules uses a repository-relative URL (../arm-recomp-core.git), so setup must map the name to this absolute URL

submodules_not_initialised.reason: Android-only; never built or linked on desktop. Left uninitialised to keep the checkout small.

patches.what: validated arm-recomp-core revision carrying the GBARECOMP_TAIL_* transfer emission
netplay transport fixes (requires network enabled in the framework CMake options)

patch_application_note: Each patch applies with `git apply` inside the checkout named by `applies_to`, at the commit recorded for that repository. tools/regeneration/setup-framework.ps1 loops over this array, so this file is the single source of truth for repositories, commits and patches.

local_snapshot.note: This path is git-ignored and is not a published dependency. It is the validated working copy the pins above were derived from; it can always be recreated by setup-framework.ps1.

framework_generated_files_policy.rule: BIOS-derived generated C++ is never published: generated/cart/ and generated/bios/ are git-ignored and are recreated by tools/regeneration/regen.ps1 from the user's own BIOS dump.
framework_generated_files_policy.conflict_resolution: regen.ps1 clears generated/bios/ before generating, so the copies committed by 01-gbarecomp.patch under reference/gbarecomp/src/runtime/generated_bios/ can never override freshly regenerated output.

sdl2.note: not used by the gba_recompile generator build; the host runtime window/audio stack resolves SDL2 from the environment (never a repo-internal path)

verified_builds.what: gba_recompile (framework generator) from the validated snapshot, out-of-source MSVC Release
